channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the materials sector.

item.title: Tongyang: Korea Exchange warns Tongyang 2nd preferred shares (new type) face delisting risk for market capitalization below KRW 2bn.
item.description: Delisting risk, market cap below KRW 2bn

item.title: KleanNara: KRX warns KleanNara Class 1 preferred shares face delisting risk after failing the KRW 2bn market capitalization requirement
Hansol HomeDeco: Korea Exchange warns Hansol HomeDeco common stock may be designated an administrative issue as market cap stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
Wiscom: WISCOM warned its common shares may be designated an administrative issue after market cap stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
Tongyang: KRX warns Dongyang 2nd Preferred Shares (new) face delisting if market cap stays below KRW 2.0bn for 61 days.
Samyang Packaging: Samyang Packaging reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 135.7bn, up 8.33% YoY, with operating profit down 18.65%.
Nexen Tire: Nexen Tire's Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated results show revenue of KRW 814.8bn and a net loss of KRW 46.6bn.
